images.title: Expanded form of 5,207
images.purpose: Show that the expanded form adds the value of each digit, and that a zero place adds nothing to the sum but still holds its place.
images.composition: A place value chart fills the upper part: four columns, one row of tokens and a row of value boxes under it. The sum line is the largest text, across the bottom.
images.exact_structure: Plain white 16:9 canvas. UPPER PART: a chart of four equal columns side by side with thin dark outlines. The header row reads, left to right: Th, H, T, O. Under the header is one tall row of four cells. Cell Th holds exactly 5 round tokens, each printed 1,000, teal #0072B2 with white numbers, arranged 3 on top and 2 below. Cell H holds exactly 2 round tokens, each printed 100, amber #E69F00 with dark numbers, side by side. Cell T holds no token: it shows one empty dashed slot, the size of a token, outlined in #CC79A7. Cell O holds exactly 7 small round tokens, each printed 1, green #009E73 with white numbers, arranged 4 on top and 3 below. The token colours only tell the columns apart; the printed number on each token is its value. MIDDLE: directly under the four cells, a row of four value boxes: 5,000 under Th, 200 under H, 0 under T (grey #6B7280 text), 7 under O. BOTTOM, across the full width in the largest type: 5,207 = 5,000 + 200 + 7. Thin dark arrows run from the value boxes 5,000, 200 and 7 down to the matching terms of the sum line. The 0 box has no arrow. Nothing else is drawn.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: A number is the sum of the values of its digits. A zero adds nothing to the sum, but it still holds its place.
images.description: The tokens of 5,207 in a place value chart, the value of each column, and the sum that makes the number, with the empty tens place left out of the sum.
images.context: Starting point is the chapter's token charts for a number grouped under its expanded form. The number is the plan's own 5,207 from the concept's first worked example. The second example number is not drawn, to keep one idea on the picture. The label 1,000 is printed on each of the 5 thousand tokens, 100 on each of the 2 hundred tokens and 1 on each of the 7 ones tokens.
images.teaching_notes: Count aloud: 5 thousands, 2 hundreds, no tens, 7 ones. Ask where the 0 went in the sum, then why the 2 still sits in the hundreds place. Misconception M_ZERO_HOLDER: the tens place holds a zero, so no other digit moves.

image_decisions.why: The tokens grouped under the sum make the value of each digit, and the zero place that adds nothing, visible at a glance.
